title: Get Ready to Slay Demons on the Go: Diablo 4 May Be Coming to Switch 2!
summary:
Imagine battling hordes of demons while riding the bus or lounging in your backyard. That dream might come true soon! Whispers say that Diablo 4, the super popular action game, is sneaking onto the Nintendo Switch 2.

How do we know? Well, sneaky rating boards in other countries accidentally posted listings for a Switch 2 version of the game before quickly deleting them. Oops! A French website called Dealabs Magazine says the game could launch on September 15 or 18, costing $69.99. But here's a weird twist: the box might not have a game cartridge. Instead, you'd get a code to download the game. So, it's a 'code in a box.'

Blizzard, the company that makes Diablo 4, hasn't said 'yes' or 'no' yet. But they've put Diablo games on Switch before. Diablo 3 came out in 2018, and Diablo 2: Resurrected followed in 2021. So, it's not a huge surprise.

If it's real, we might get an official announcement at Gamescom, a big video game show happening soon. Xbox (which owns Blizzard now) will be there with tons of games. Imagine slaying monsters with the new Spiritborn class from the Lord of Hatred expansion on a handheld! The Switch 2 can handle big games, but we'll have to see how smoothly Diablo 4 runs. Fingers crossed for a demon-slaying commute!
why_it_matters: If the rumor is true, gamers will be able to enjoy a big-budget adventure anywhere, which could change how they play—and might make you look forward to future game releases for new consoles.

background_read: The Nintendo Switch is a popular handheld game system that can also connect to a TV; the Switch 2 is its next version.
Diablo 4 is an action role-playing game where players fight demons, made by Blizzard Entertainment, now part of Xbox.
Rating boards like the ESRB in the US or PEGI in Europe give age ratings to video games and sometimes leak new releases by accident.
Article_Structure: WHO: Blizzard Entertainment (owned by Xbox) and video game rating boards.
WHAT: Rumors that the action game Diablo 4 will be released for the Nintendo Switch 2 as a 'code in a box,' without a physical cartridge.
WHERE: Information leaked online from rating boards in other countries and from a French website, Dealabs Magazine.
WHY: Because former Diablo games appeared on Nintendo Switch before, and an official announcement might happen at the Gamescom event.

perspectives.description: Playing Diablo 4 on the go would be amazing! The Switch 2 can handle big games, so slaying demons during car rides sounds awesome.
I prefer buying physical game cartridges because I can keep them forever. A 'code in a box' feels like I'm not really owning the game.
Blizzard has a history of bringing games to Nintendo platforms, so this move makes sense to reach more players, even if it's download-only.
